context.transcript:
I have one final issue to discuss at today's staff meeting.
I just handed out a graph summarizing our shoe store's annual sales data.
And, well, I think this information is particularly interesting since we relocated to a different neighborhood this year.
As you might have expected, the relocation decreased our sales significantly at first.
During the quarter we moved, we experienced the lowest shoe sales of the entire year.
That was largely because people in the new neighborhood didn't know about us.
However, thanks to the newspaper advertisements and radio commercials we put out, business picked up quickly.
And we ended the year by making a record number of sales.
context.transcript_translation:
我今天员工会议上还有一个最终问题要讨论。
我刚刚分发了一份总结我们鞋店年度销售数据的图表。
而且，嗯，我认为这个信息特别有趣，因为今年我们搬到了不同的社区。
正如你可能预期的那样，搬迁初期使我们的销售额显著下降了。
在搬家季度，我们经历了全年最低的鞋类销量。
这主要是因为新社区的人们不知道我们这里。
然而，多亏了我们投放的新闻广告和广播商业广告，生意很快就恢复了。
并且我们以创纪录的销售额结束了这一年。
